tool_args.rationale: The observations are nearly proportional to u_now, but all horizons are tightly clustered near the forecast horizon and s_grad is fixed at zero. Given the slow-horizon query and damped-transient signatures, a fine trajectory batch is the available relevant probe to separate static response from relaxation before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Static linear model y = c0 + c1*u_now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The ratios y/u_now are close to constant, but the slow-horizon and damped-transient signatures leave a plausible H-dependent mechanism that these near-identical horizons cannot distinguish.
Five observations cluster around H≈4 and do not identify horizon dependence reliably; the fine trajectory batch can test whether an initial-state transient remains.
It is unrelated to distinguishing the supported smooth mechanisms and has no identified need.
